llm.summary: The skill is a coherent local note/export tool, but it needs Review because deleted images/files can remain stored locally and its no-network privacy promise is not fully accurate.

dimensions.detail: Browser localStorage, IndexedDB, clipboard paste/copy, file selection, drag-and-drop, and local downloads are proportionate for the tool. However, the documented local-only/no-network boundary is weakened by user-triggered requests to ClawHub for version checks and external navigation to ClawHub and Google Forms.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a static HTML file with inline JavaScript and no observed package dependencies, installers, startup hooks, or automatic system modification. The packaging command in the documentation is a distribution instruction rather than an automatic install path.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructions are mostly descriptive and do not contain agent hijacking, hidden role changes, or unsafe execution instructions. The trigger description is somewhat broad, including generic note/clipboard tooling and HTML-to-skill packaging requests, which may over-invoke the skill but is not by itself malicious.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Local browser persistence is expected for this app, and there is no OS-level persistence or background service. The concern is incomplete deletion: notes moved to trash/drafts can lose image references while image blobs remain, folder deletion can leave file blobs, and permanent purge of file trash metadata does not delete the original IndexedDB record.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main capability matches the stated purpose: a single-file Chinese note board that stores notes, images, uploaded files, reminders, and exports .docx files locally. The concern is that privacy-related behavior does not fully match the claims: some supposedly permanent deletions leave IndexedDB blobs behind, and update/feedback controls contact external services despite no-network documentation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with browser-local storage retaining sensitive content unless the publisher fixes deletion cleanup. Treat the app as mostly local, not strictly offline: checking updates, following the upgrade link, or opening feedback can contact ClawHub or Google. Avoid storing highly sensitive documents or images until the deletion and disclosure issues are addressed.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced HTML artifact was present in the workspace and was inspected directly, so the scanner's partial-inspection concern is overridden for this adjudication.
[SQP-1] expected: The invocation wording is broad and should be narrowed, but the artifact behavior remains tied to note collection, local file/image management, and Word export.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The update check and upgrade link are user-triggered and do not send stored note content, but they contradict the skill's unconditional no-network claim.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The version-check fetch expands the trust boundary for a tool presented as offline; no remote code retrieval or execution was observed.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only UI matches the Chinese skill description and product materials; this is a usability/localization note, not a security escalation.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The feedback button opens a Google Forms URL only after user action and does not attach local app content, but the external destination is not disclosed in the skill documentation.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The feedback navigation is optional, but it is under-disclosed for a tool whose materials state that it does not use the network.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding about deleted images and files remaining in IndexedDB is supported by the artifact: several deletion and purge paths remove metadata without deleting the corresponding stored blobs.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding about offline privacy claims conflicting with external network operations is supported: documentation says no network, while the HTML includes ClawHub update traffic and Google Forms feedback navigation.
